what: Retro re-check of every APPROVED live Honda against the glazing / flat-shell / global-alpha rules, none of which existed when Honda was published. Every row comes from pipeline/ingest/glass_probe.py probe(url=desktopGlbUrl) - the same code path the wave uses, deliberately not reimplemented, so the retro check cannot drift from the wave check.
probe_validation: 358/384 against the six committed ground-truth sets after three bugs found and fixed during this audit (PORSCHE 106/107, JEEP 41/45, JAGUAR 44/48, MAZDA 75/78, VOLVO 58/64, CHRYSLER 34/42). ZERO ground-truth-clear cars now score opaque, which is the only dangerous direction under the owner ruling.
rules: opaque+proven = FAIL under the owner ruling. 'ambiguous' and opaque+inferred must NEVER be failed on the probe alone; they route to a magenta-backlight render of the shipped GLB. NOTHING has been quarantined here - these are candidates with evidence, for the owner to confirm by render. That sequencing exists because 39 live cars were quarantined on sheet evidence on 2026-08-10 and all 39 had to be restored.
